reports.title: Requirement -> Contract -> Example/Task/CodeUnit/Test
reports.query:
MATCH (r:Requirement)<-[:FORMALIZES]-(c:Contract)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:WITNESSES]-(e:Example)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:DERIVES_FROM]-(t:Task)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:IMPLEMENTS]-(cu:CodeUnit)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:CONSTRAINS]-(cf:ConfigUnit)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:TESTS]-(test:Test)
RETURN r, c, e, t, cu, cf, test
LIMIT 150

reports.title: Open Issues
reports.query: MATCH (i:Issue) WHERE i.workflow_status IN ['open', 'triaging', 'ready', 'in_progress'] RETURN count(i) AS Open_Issues

reports.title: Needs Revalidation
reports.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.verification_status = 'needs_revalidation' RETURN count(n) AS Needs_Revalidation

reports.title: Knowledge status distribution
reports.query:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.knowledge_status IS NOT NULL
RETURN n.knowledge_status AS status, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC

reports.title: Verification status distribution
reports.query:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.verification_status IS NOT NULL
RETURN n.verification_status AS status, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC

reports.title: Artifacts needing revalidation
reports.query:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.verification_status = 'needs_revalidation'
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS type, n.id AS id,
       coalesce(n.path, n.summary, n.title, n.text) AS label,
       n.updated_at AS updated_at
ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC

reports.title: Stale artifacts (semantic change pending)
reports.query:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.knowledge_status = 'stale'
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS type, n.id AS id,
       coalesce(n.summary, n.title, n.text) AS label,
       n.updated_at AS updated_at
ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC

reports.title: Open Issues (by severity)
reports.query:
MATCH (i:Issue)
WHERE i.workflow_status IN ['open', 'triaging', 'ready', 'in_progress']
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.severity AS severity,
       i.classification AS classification, i.workflow_status AS status
ORDER BY CASE i.severity
  WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1
  WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

reports.title: Blocking Clarifications (unanswered)
reports.query:
MATCH (cl:Clarification {blocking: true})-[:CLARIFIES]->(r:Requirement)
WHERE cl.answer IS NULL
RETURN cl.id AS clarification_id, cl.question AS question,
       r.id AS requirement_id, r.text AS requirement

reports.title: Open CONTRADICTS edges
reports.query:
MATCH (a)-[rel:CONTRADICTS {status: 'open'}]->(b)
RETURN labels(a)[0] AS from_type, coalesce(a.summary, a.text) AS from_label,
       labels(b)[0] AS to_type, coalesce(b.summary, b.text) AS to_label
